summary: Implemented the grid-sampled patch feature across monai/data/utils.py (iter_patch yields (patch, coords) pairs; set_rnd skips __-prefixed attributes), monai/data/grid_dataset.py (new PatchIter; reworked GridPatchDataset with injected patch_iter, transform, with_coordinates and worker partitioning; PatchDataset docstring float alias fix), monai/data/__init__.py (PatchIter export), docs/source/data.rst (PatchIter autodoc entry), and a new tests/test_grid_dataset.py (test_shape, test_loading_array, plus test_missing_length). Nothing was run and nothing was committed, per instructions. Unverified: the pinned patch values in test_loading_array may be sensitive to RNG draw order and the 1e-5 tolerance, and black formatting was checked by reading only. Choices made: the PatchIter channel Note lives in the constructor docstring; with coordinates requested, a one-element yield fails by unpacking; test images are arange(16) float 1x4x4.
